notes: Fitted by inst/memory/calibrate.R against 26 measured points on Darwin arm64 (rss-sampling), model kumo-tabular-small-classifier. Constants are for the peak_terms() formulas as they stand; changing either invalidates the other. safety_factor is whatever it takes for no measured point to sit above its own estimate. The ensemble slope is from the sweep at 3200 x 32 (measurements/ensemble-kumo.json), where the activation rather than the process is what grows; a sweep at 800 x 32 implied 0.597 but over-stated a real 8-member run at 5000 x 50 (29.3 GB) by 2x. Its cap is raised from 2.13 to 2.7 so the 800 x 32 sweep's 32-member point (9.8 GB) is still covered.
